turn_1.decision_relevance: Directly tests the customer objective by tenant class and provides the evidence needed for promotion.
turn_1.expected_observation: Held-out measurement will likely show that mean improvement does not reliably imply p99 below 250 ms for every tenant class; some classes may still exceed the threshold.

turn_2.lesson: Aggregate mean latency can conceal a tenant-specific p99 regression; global promotion requires every tenant class to meet the p99 objective and preserve non-inferiority.
